description_en: Modifies the configuration of a cloud phone matrix. Currently, only the instance type and the number of cloud phone instances (the instance count of the cloud phone matrix) can be changed
description_zh: 变更云手机矩阵的配置，目前仅支持变更实例规格和云手机实例开数（实例开数即云手机矩阵的实例数量）
kebab_example: aliyun eds-aic change-cloud-phone-node --node-id cpn-0ugbptfu473fy0000 --instance-type ac.max --phone-count 20 --up-bandwidth-limit 50 --down-bandwidth-limit 50 --phone-data-volume 10 --auto-pay false --promotion-id 500033080110000 --display-config example-string --swap-size 1 --share-data-volume 1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ChangeCloudPhoneNode

parameters.help_en: The number of cloud phone instances. Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2807299.html operation to query the maximum and minimum instance count limits
